audio.narration_direction_english: Brazilian Portuguese, natural regional pronunciation, clear documentary storytelling, emotionally controlled and intelligible. Male-presenting, low, resonant, solemn, measured, cinematic but not theatrical; emphasize dates and revelations with short pauses. Write and perform only the Portuguese spoken script after the colon. Use short natural pauses after dates, numbers and revelations; do not sound rushed.
audio.music_prompt_english: Instrumental only, no vocals. Elegant piano, soft synth bed, gentle cinematic percussion, premium restrained build, open ending for a clear call to action. Tempo target: 78–100 BPM. Duration: approximately 30.0 seconds.
mix_rules: Narration stays intelligible and in front.
Duck music by approximately 8 dB under speech, then adjust by ear.
Use SFX only for visible or narratively justified events.
Leave a clean 1.5–2 second musical tail at the ending.
